notes: A flight reconstruction of the STS-36 motor pair, not a static test: thrust was not measured - it is reconstructed from head-end pressure with static-test-average conversion factors (section 3.2), and must never be read as measured thrust. No DFI high-rate gauges flew, so the ignition interval and pressure-rise rate are not available and are not supplied. Pc(t) exists only as scanned plots (Figures 3.3 and 3.4), not digitised. The grain is four segments, undimensioned (Figure 1.1). The burn-rate reference points and the Table 3.2 reconstruction outputs are cited, not carried: firing data belong to later evidence work.
